selection: 8 audited development records: first complete pair from each of three families, plus the second revision pair covering the other observed A failure. Posthoc selection, four original task blocks.
critical_controls: 6 coherent changes to a budget cap or initial requested/permitted date; all executed actions and later permissions fixed; labels must flip.
irrelevant_controls: 8 consistent opaque receipt-ID renamings; labels must remain unchanged.
fact_repair_limit: Auditor removes verdicts and unsupported additions and repairs source binding; combines presentation, selection and correction. Not a pure typography intervention, token-matched comparison, independent gold, or natural actor output.
secondary_model_limit: gpt-oss previously generated answers but acts here as a fresh tool-disabled Judge. Cross-model check, not independent human gold. Different native output decoding, report failures explicitly.
failure_metrics: All scheduled positions remain denominators. Null, truncation, invalid schema, timeout and undispatched each reported; never converted to clean negative.

interpretation.question_only_matches_actual: Question/extra prompt structure may suffice; cannot credit answer evidence uniquely.
interpretation.repair_or_card_recovers_actual_error: Presentation/correction helps this Judge, conditional on same record and case.
interpretation.card_fails_but_secondary_succeeds: Model-specific interpretation/read-out bottleneck candidate, not proof of internal mechanism.
interpretation.critical_change_ignored: Output not sensitive to a label-determining public fact in this diagnostic.
interpretation.irrelevant_change_flips: Instability under a semantically irrelevant identifier change.
interpretation.all_conditions_ceiling: Existing cases do not identify the bottleneck; no broad effectiveness or causal-use claim.

stop_rule: One allocation, <=7200 sec; <=136 dispatches; <=323584 reserved output tokens; 240 sec per call; no retries, no new trajectories, no training, no automatic scale-up. Fatal worker/asset/budget error ends campaign.

audit_freeze.reviewer: single context-aware assistant, not independent human gold
audit_freeze.masking_limit: Arm/seed hidden in response-reading batches; prior two cases and historical aggregate results already known; metadata available in workspace. Not a fully blinded independent study.

authorization.user_authorization: OK 那就第一步你来负责 然后一直推进下去 另外bouchet的登陆只需要你点signin就行 他会自动鉴权的
authorization.scope: Complete existing-data evidence-content audit and autonomously progress to a bounded controlled diagnostic of evidence provision versus Judge use. User authorizes ordinary Bouchet sign-in.
authorization.pre_submission_requirement: Finish source audit; freeze specific diagnostic contrasts, labels, input scope, call/token bounds, and stop rules; pass offline tests and cluster asset admission. Earlier stopped jobs and consumed permits are not reused.
authorization.review_limit: Single context-aware AI audit, not independent human gold.
